scripts.concat: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const concat = require('concat'); const pkg = require('./package.json'); fs.mkdirSync('releases', { recursive: true }); concat(['header.js', '.out/main.user.js'], 'releases/release-' + pkg.version + '.user.js').catch(e => { console.error(e); process.exit(1); });"
scripts.build: npm run compile && npm run concat
scripts.release: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const pkg = require('./package.json'); const h = fs.readFileSync('header.js', 'utf8'); fs.writeFileSync('header.js', h.replace(/\d+\.\d+\.\d+/, pkg.version));" && cross-env NODE_ENV=production npm run build
